register.title: Create your vault
register.subtitle: Private by design. Delivered only when it matters.
register.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. A long, uncommon phrase works best.
register.passwordTooWeak: This password is too easy to guess. Use a longer, less common phrase.

recoveryKey.title: Your Recovery Key
recoveryKey.explain: This key is the only way to unlock your vault if you ever forget your password. We cannot recover it for you — it is never sent to our servers.
recoveryKey.lossWarning: If you lose both your password and this key, your vault is unrecoverable. That is by design: no one but you can open it.
recoveryKey.ackLabel: I have saved this key somewhere safe
recoveryKey.oldInvalid: Your previous Recovery Key no longer works.

login.title: Welcome back
login.totpHint: Enter the code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.
login.vaultLockedBody: Your account access has been restored, but your vault is still locked. Use your Recovery Key to unlock it.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.explain: Enter your email and we will send a reset link if an account exists.
forgot.vaultNote: Resetting your password restores account access only — your vault stays locked until you enter your Recovery Key. This is how your privacy is protected.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password updated. Sign in with your new password — then unlock your vault with your Recovery Key.

recovery.title: Unlock your vault
recovery.explain: Enter your Recovery Key to unlock your vault and re-secure it under your current password. A new Recovery Key will be issued.
recovery.badChecksum: That doesn't look like a valid Recovery Key — check for typos.
recovery.wrongKey: That Recovery Key does not unlock this vault.
